aliases: Dual Lens Outdoor Security Camera Hub

storage.notes: microSD up to 512GB; cloud storage not supported (local recording).

features: Dual 4MP lenses: fixed wide-angle overview plus PTZ tracking lens (260 degrees pan / 90 degrees tilt)
Built-in Zigbee 3.0 hub for SONOFF sub-devices
Local AI detection: people, vehicles, pets, motion; Home/Away/Sleep security modes
Dual-band Wi-Fi (802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax) plus wired Ethernet (RJ45 10/100)
RTSP and ONVIF support (ONVIF adds PTZ control, audio toggle, detection events)
IP65, up to 512GB local storage, audio and red/blue light alarms, no monthly fee

frigate.notes: Use RTSP (HD or SD stream); enable in device. Add via ONVIF for PTZ/detection.

home_assistant.notes: Generic Camera via RTSP (HD/SD live) or ONVIF integration (SD live, PTZ control, audio toggle, motion/person/vehicle/pet events).

blue_iris.notes: Add as ONVIF/RTSP camera; ONVIF exposes PTZ.
